arms.A_specialist: binary L2 logistic, balanced, C=0.001, under-40 training rows only
arms.B_reweight: control + sample weight x5.0 under-40 escalating, x3.0 benign rows with H0 escalation mass >= the benign 90% quantile
arms.C_metadata: control + sex, anatomic site (one-hot, missing level) and age/100 (median-filled) + age-missing indicator
arms.control: 7-way L2 logistic, class_weight=balanced, C=0.001, escalation mass

cross_fitting.aggregation: mean of the per-repeat out-of-fold scores
cross_fitting.splitter: StratifiedGroupKFold on group_id, strata = (under-40 escalating, escalating)

declared_dependence: ham_val chose the checkpoint epoch; S58's C was selected on V4 val, which is inside the development rows. Both are common to every arm, so they bias levels, not contrasts
excluded: HAM train (in-sample for the trunk); reserved and ham_test never loaded
no_tuning: every C, weight and quantile above is fixed here; nothing is selected

primary.gate: PASS iff delta >= 0.03 and the adjusted interval's lower bound > 0; runbook's 95% interval tightened for three arms
primary.interval: lesion-grouped paired bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 42, percentile at 1 - 0.05/3
primary.quantity: under-40 pAUC@0.20 (McClish), arm minus control, development rows
primary.stage2: only PASS arms are handed to the user as a GPU fine-tune

prior: low: S51 (foundation models) and S54 (pooled training) left under-40 ranking flat
question: does a head objective / data weighting change move under-40 escalation pAUC@0.20 on frozen HAM-only ConvNeXt-Tiny features?
